headline: Old results: Butterfly filed its Q3 8-K on 10/29 before the open; today's item is a late summary
reasoning: Source: Butterfly Network's Q3 2026 release; its 2.02 8-K was accepted by the SEC at 06:33 ET on 10/29 (10-Q at 06:40 ET). Benzinga's 09:02 ET item today relays it via NatLawReview: 'revenue of $32.6 million, representing a 52% increase ... raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $123 million to $126 million'.
A full session (10/29) has traded the results. Pre-market today on the consolidated tape: 7.29 vs 7.505, -2.9% on 10,319 shares. That move is unrelated to a day-old release.
objections: Released a day ago and traded by a full session.
